home.title: Strategic Legal Representation for U.S. Immigration Matters
home.description: Clients are represented directly by a licensed U.S. attorney. Every case is developed with precision, discretion, and a tailored legal strategy.
attorney.label: Attorney Leadership
attorney.name: Dr. Eyad Al-Samhan
attorney.body1: Dr. Eyad Al-Samhan is an immigration and business attorney with an academic and professional background spanning international law, constitutional law, and cross-border legal matters.
attorney.body2: He holds a doctorate in international and constitutional law, awarded with highest honors (summa cum laude), and a Master of Laws (LL.M.) from Brigham Young University in the United States.
attorney.body3: He leads all legal strategy, case evaluation, and final review at Cabral Alsamhan PLLC.
about.title: About Us
about.lede: Cabral Alsamhan PLLC is a boutique law firm specializing in immigration and business law for international professionals, entrepreneurs, and investors seeking premium legal representation.
about.sets.title: What Sets Us Apart
about.sets.body: We are a law firm providing direct legal representation, not just document-preparation services. Dr. Eyad Al-Samhan is personally involved in every case from initial consultation through resolution. We provide direct attorney oversight, strategic case planning, and individualized legal solutions - not generic templates or outsourced work.
about.service.title: White Glove Service
about.service.body: Every client receives dedicated support from a qualified case manager who coordinates all aspects of your case. Your case manager serves as your primary point of contact, ensuring seamless communication, timely updates, and personalized attention throughout the entire legal process.
practice.title: Practice Areas
practice.intro: Cabral Alsamhan PLLC provides attorney-led representation across immigration and business-related legal matters for international professionals, entrepreneurs, investors, and globally mobile clients.
practice.business.title: Business Immigration
practice.business.description: Strategic visa and residency planning for founders, executives, multinational teams, and professionals pursuing lawful U.S. business mobility.
practice.investor.title: Investor Visas
practice.investor.description: Counsel for investors and entrepreneurs seeking investment-based immigration pathways, including business structuring and petition strategy.
practice.employment.title: Employment-Based Immigration
practice.employment.description: Attorney-led preparation for employment-based petitions, work authorization matters, and long-term immigration planning for qualified professionals.
practice.family.title: Family-Based Immigration
practice.family.description: Careful representation for family petitions, adjustment matters, consular processing, and related filings designed to bring families together lawfully.
practice.citizenship.title: Citizenship & Naturalization
practice.citizenship.description: Guidance through eligibility review, application preparation, interview readiness, and the final steps toward U.S. citizenship.
practice.removal.title: Removal Defense
practice.removal.description: Representation in immigration court matters, removal defense strategy, bond issues, evidence preparation, and related proceedings.
practice.asylum.title: Asylum & Humanitarian Relief
practice.asylum.description: Discreet, thorough representation for asylum, humanitarian protections, and sensitive immigration matters requiring detailed case development.
practice.corporate.title: Corporate & Business Law
practice.corporate.description: Legal support for company formation, contracts, governance, commercial planning, and cross-border business operations in the United States.
practice.litigation.title: Federal Litigation & Appeals
practice.litigation.description: Strategic representation in complex federal matters, agency-related disputes, appeals, and high-stakes legal challenges.
practice.complex.title: Strategic & Complex Filings
practice.complex.description: Premium attorney-led planning for complex immigration and business filings requiring careful legal analysis, documentation strategy, and direct oversight.
